# EasyNaukri Platform

EasyNaukri is an automated job application & resume matching platform that helps job seekers streamline candidate outreach, track applications, and optimize resume matching.

## Key Features & Navigational Links

- [Candidate Dashboard](https://easynaukri.online/dashboard): Universal career passport, overview metrics, and daily learning habits.
- [Opportunity Tracker](https://easynaukri.online/opportunities/tracker): Track and organize submitted job applications.
- [Email Templates](https://easynaukri.online/outreach/templates): Customizable recruiter outreach templates.
- [Learning Space](https://easynaukri.online/learning): Skill building, coding challenges, and career roadmaps.
- [About EasyNaukri](https://easynaukri.online/about): Platform mission and company information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://easynaukri.online/privacy): Terms and data protection policy.

## Technical Architecture

Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and WebMCP integration for AI agent compatibility.
